scenarios.name: Preserve a staged ribbon edit while viewing keyboard customization

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has an empty Part Tools custom panel
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel
the user selects the "Keyboard" customization tab
the keyboard command list is displayed
the user returns to the "Ribbon" customization tab
"2D Sketches" remains in the Part Tools custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
